The '''Salvage Yard''' was a large construction site located in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] which was built by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a metal recycling facility. Scrap metal was compacted into large blocks and directed through a series of rings that formed a flexible conduit to a smelting room. Molten metal from the smelter flowed to a centrifuge, where individual metals were separated and cooled into ingots, before passing through the rings to storage and shipping facilities. Soon after its construction, Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] began using the Salvage Yard as an unofficial training facility, flying a series of courses through the rings and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] as a test of their skill. This was not condoned by [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], but no effort was made to halt the practice. The Rebel pilots referred to the Salvage Yard as the "[[pilot proving grounds]]."
